game_updates.contents: This update has the same version for both the official release and the betaChangelog Optimized the Launchpad display animation.Added an option to disable GPU multi-threaded optimization (toggle via Preferences > Global Settings). game_updates.title: Full Release 7.27.3 STABLE Released!
game_updates.contents: We've now released v7.27.3 onto the main branches, and the consolidated patch notes can be found below.Gameplay Changes:The Laser Weapons research entry has been updated so the displayed damage multiplier is now 120% rather than 135%, which accurately reflects the pre-upgrade damage values of Laser weapons. The research text has also been updated to better hint at the possibility of future upgrades.Mods now no longer have a "maximum version", as this was causing a lot of false confusion about mods being out of date. Generally speaking our "major version" patches should not break mods - so a mod made in V7 should work in all versions of post-release V7. The game now only generates a warning if we move onto the next major version (e.g. V8).Bugfixes:Fixed a bug preventing users uploading mods...

game_updates.title: Helldivers 2 getting an upgraded level cap probably isn't what that spooky teddy bear teaser was about, but is almost definitely in preparation for it
game_updates.contents: Tonally mercurial co-op shooter Helldivers 2 is boosting its level cap, again, in another hint that something big is brewing in the blackness of its endlessly war-torn galaxy. Following a previous increase from 50 to 150, developers Arrowhead are bumping the cap to level 300 in an upcoming patch, with any XP that you would have gained since hitting the previous limit set to apply retroactively. I wonder if any dive-happy souls out there have banked enough well-done points to instantly jump from 150 to 300 the moment they log in? No judgement here. Questions, maybe, but not judgement. The announcement post doesn’t specific a date or patch number for when the higher cap takes effect, though the announcement itself comes just a day after this curious teaser video, showing a teddy bear in Hell...

game_updates.title: HELLDIVERS 2 Is Raising the Level Cap to 300
game_updates.contents: Attention, Helldivers. Super Earth has authorized a new tier of service, and it's a big one: the level cap is jumping from 150 all the way to 300.If you are already sore from the democratic path to 150, take a breath before you panic, this update comes with some genuinely great news for anyone who's already put in the hours.A Quick History of the CapLaunch cap: Level 50April 2024: Tripled to level 150Now: Doubling again to level 300Each time the cap has risen, it's been paired with new titles, ranks, and bragging rights for the players who've stuck around–from our veterans of Malevelon Creek, to our soldiers in the Battle for Super Earth, to those brave divers who held the Menkent Line and beyond. This time is no different; level 300 is arriving as part of a broader progression overhaul th...

During the event, the Skeleton returns to the Tavern with a special new quest to celebrate the anniversary.We've also fixed several major bugs that affected gameplay, made a number of balance adjustments, and improved the ping system to enhance the overall party-play experience. Looking ahead, we'll keep adding more Quality of Life (QoL) improvements to improve the overall experience.Finally, we're closely analyzing the data from the Normal and High-Roller mode changes introduced last season. game_updates.contents: The update fixes the following: Fixed Master Anglers bonus item drop rate which had been lower than it should be. Extended Master Anglers event runtime by 1 week to compensate. game_updates.title: 30 DAYS LEFT!
game_updates.contents: As part of the 8AM series, this new entry takes players into a warehouse environment where observation, attention to detail, and quick decision-making are essential. Players will monitor camera feeds, identify anomalies, and report anything that should not be there before the situation escalates.With only one month remaining until release, we invite you to add 8AM: The Warehouse to your Steam wishlist and follow the game to stay updated ahead of launch.Thank you for your continued support.

game_updates.title: Apex Legends™: Marked Patch Notes
game_updates.contents: INTROWelcome to the latest season of Apex Legends: MARKED. In addition to Bloodhound’s rework, buffs to Loba and Rampart, an energy weapon systems overhaul, and brand new Corrupted Attachments, we’re also bringing you a World’s Edge map rework, quality of life tweaks, and a slew of balancing changes. All of this is in pursuit of evolving Apex Legends into the best, most competitive Battle Royale out there. This season is going to push you and your squad to be the best you can possibly be, so get ready to group up, gear up, and dive into MARKED when it drops on August 4th, 2026!MATCHMAKING TESTSIn Season 29, we ran two matchmaking tests — 1-Tier Premade Restrictions and Diamond+ Solo-Queue-Only — to experiment with variables to potentially use to address player frustrations in Ranked.
